msgTextWelcome.message:
Before you start, please take these two extra steps to ensure better experience with Chrono.
1. Disable browser's Save As dialog so that you won't be asked where to save file for every download. This can be done by clearing the checkbox before $1.
2. Allow Chrono to access file URLs for fast file preview, by ticking the checkbox $2 on $3.
If you have any question, please visit our Help page and FAQ page.

updateLogMessage_v0_12_0_mv3.message:
After several months of work, Chrono Download Manager has now been upgraded to the latest Chrome Manifest V3, following all best practices for Chrome extensions. This means it now uses less memory and resources on your computer, and you'll no longer see any deprecation warnings in Chrome.
Looking ahead, we're excited to keep improving CDM with updates that enhance your experience and ensure the extension remains sustainable for the future. Thank you for your continued support!

updateLogMessage_v0_13_0.message: This update addresses stability issues and introduces several feature enhancements: you can now open download manager in a standalone window, preview filenames before downloads begin, and open files directly by clicking notifications.

checkerplus_showNotificationsForOlderDat.message: Show notifications for older dated emails (Useful only for POP3 accounts)

If unchecked, popup notifications will only occur for your newest emails (recommended for most), but sometimes emails fetched using POP3 will arrive in your inbox after your newest emails and are sorted in the middle of your inbox because of their older dates. If you check this option those emails will also appear in your popup notifications but only to maximum of 20 unread emails in your inbox. Note: If you mark emails as unread they will also popup notifications again!
